metadata.title: On the vortex filament conjecture for the Gross-Pitaevskii equation
metadata.abstract: We establish one form of the vortex filament conjecture for the three-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation. Given any smooth closed embedded binormal flow of curves on a compact time interval, we construct, in the small-core limit $\varepsilon\to0$, a family of exact solutions whose degree-one vortex filaments converge uniformly to the prescribed flow. Near the filament the solutions have the standard planar vortex profile, while away from it their phase gradients converge to the associated Biot-Savart field. We also derive a refined modulation law for the vortex filament.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者对任意给定的光滑闭嵌入双法向曲线流，在紧时间区间上构造三维 Gross–Pitaevskii 精确解族，使小核极限的一级涡线一致逼近该流。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时控制近涡线剖面、远场相位梯度，并给出细化的涡线调制律。
analysis.limitations: 是涡线猜想的一种构造性形式，针对预先给定的光滑流及有限时间；不等同于任意初值收敛定理。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 几何流与非线性 PDE 的重要连接，篇幅长，建议先核查主定理和误差框架。
